pages.title: Bottle the Storm
pages.text: Open the lightning school’s material route through a charged creeper.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use an empty bottle on a charged creeper under the native rule. Prepare distance and defense; an ordinary creeper is not charged. The focus supports lightning-school forging.
